title: Today (live X3+)
line: Flat cream with a dot grid behind everything; flat orange and blue CSS ray grounds; a dark ray ground on Upcoming.

title: G1 · One city at night  ($0.39)
line: One painted city (gpt-image-2 2K) fixed behind the whole page, drifting slower than the scroll; sections are tinted gels the city glows through; wider gutters show it; Upcoming days sit on newsprint panels.

title: G2 · The comic page itself  ($0.21)
line: Aged newsprint, a hand-ruled ink page edge, a registration target and colour bar over each section; the section inks printed off register (a sliver of bare paper); Upcoming in black ink with an inked gold burst.

title: G3 · A backdrop per section  ($0.76)
line: Painted plaster wall; Meet the models in the backstage corridor (orange-graded), Every round on the newsstand street, Upcoming in the arena under its spotlight.

title: G4 · Risograph, two inks  ($0.21)
line: Cream riso paper; each section solid riso ink with the other ink overprinted as a hand-cut burst behind the headline; Upcoming blue with an orange burst.

title: G5 · Cut-paper diorama  ($0.80)
line: Kraft card page; each section a stack of hand-cut card with real shadows; Upcoming a cut-paper arena with a gold-foil spotlight.

title: G6 · Painted gouache, carte blanche  ($0.19)
line: No print devices at all: painted canvas page, brushed orange and blue fields with a painted light pool behind each headline, a painted night arena on Upcoming.
